> **Scope note:** v1.0 froze the course — we accept bug fixes, documentation
> improvements and CI upkeep, but no new large lessons
> (see COURSE_COMPLETE.md). Research-direction ideas belong in
> [microdrone-world-model](https://github.com/csinghans/microdrone-world-model).

**What to improve**
Which lesson/doc, and what's unclear or wrong?

**Proposed change**
One paragraph. If it changes measured claims, say which numbers and how
they'd be re-measured.

**Both languages?**
Changes must land in the English and 繁體中文 halves together — are you able
to do both, or do you need help with one?
